title: Lane lint covers the checks job only.
ruling: Coordinator ruling, 02:57 CST Nov 8: "lane lint covers the `checks` job only." A picked suite whose CI step is in another job prints one `not run` line naming the job and its suites. A follow-up PR in this lane runs the merge and guard suites under their own time limit.
quote: Coordinator ruling, 02:57 CST Nov 8: lane lint covers the `checks` job only.
